incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are operating a hose to extinguish a large fire engulfing a house, with heavy black smoke billowing into the sky.

observations.description: Large plume of black smoke rising from the house.
Visible orange flames burning through the roof and side of the house.
Roof and walls of the house are damaged by fire.
A house with white siding and a dark roof, partially destroyed by fire.
No vehicles visible in the image.
Three firefighters in gear standing on a grassy slope, operating a hose.
